CustomField.description: Unrestricted picklist written by the NPC engine. Ships with 15 levels. Distinct from the FQS Donor Grouping fields, which are org-branded (Entry / Mid / Major) and configured via FQS_Donor_Grouping__mdt.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set automatically. The dollar band that classifies this donor's giving — one of the platform-defined levels from Under $100 through $25,000,000+.
